trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate aperture angle of 38-42 degrees based on lobe-to-lobe orientation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge is predominantly linear with low-amplitude micro-serrations. Right lobe trailing edge is severely discontinuous, terminating in a jagged, near-vertical boundary instead of a tapered tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe shows a smooth convex trajectory ending in a sharp distal point. Right lobe shows an interrupted convex sweep that is truncated at approximately 70% of expected lobe length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe structural loss/amputation of the right distal lobe tip, resulting in a blunt, irregular trailing boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Extreme morphological asymmetry between the intact left lobe and the truncated right lobe.
